mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a must for industries, which often requires them even pulling out underground elements."
Natural Resource Use Raw material is a must for industries, which often requires them even pulling out underground elements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process whereby populations move from rural to urban areas, thus enabling cities and towns to grow."
Urbanisation is a process whereby populations move from rural to urban areas, thus enabling cities and towns to grow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a colony of the British Empire and has been at the receiving end of aid for advancement."
Nigeria is a colony of the British Empire and has been at the receiving end of aid for advancement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of usurpation, plundering and expropriation."
The process of industrialisation is a process of usurpation, plundering and expropriation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of converting waste materials into new materials and objects."
Recycling is the process of converting waste materials into new materials and objects.
fib: ______ refers to a period when there was a rise in technology that led to increase in industrial and productive activities in England and flourished to other parts of Europe.
The industrial revolution refers to a period when there was a rise in technology that led to increase in industrial and productive activities in England and flourished to other parts of Europe.
______ is the process of shifting an economy away from a single income source toward multiple sources from a growing range of sectors and markets (United Nations Climate Change, 2018).

Economic diversification Economic diversification is the process of shifting an economy away from a single income source toward multiple sources from a growing range of sectors and markets (United Nations Climate Change, 2018).
______ is a biodiversity (that is, a collectivity of species including man).
The environment is a biodiversity (that is, a collectivity of species including man).
______ means a country has fashioned all aspects of her industry to play a role in the global market in terms of exporting her goods and services to derive foreign exchange.

Export-oriented industrialisation in earnest means a country has fashioned all aspects of her industry to play a role in the global market in terms of exporting her goods and services to derive foreign exchange.
